title: PIXL 8000 Pixl Dust Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Pixl Dust offers a playful blend of sweet Mixed Berries and fizzy Sherbet notes for a tangy, vibrant vape experience. It’s a sparkling flavour that adds a dash of magic to your MTL setup. This pod comes filled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and includes a 10ml refill reservoir. When connected to the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, the setup delivers up to 8000 puffs with consistent mesh coil performance. With easy draw activation and optional Boost Mode, Pixl Dust brings fizzy berry flavour with none of the fuss. One of the most unique options in the collection — ideal for adventurous vapers.
